metadata.overture_modifications: Modified from Overture Places release 2026-07-22.0 on 2026-09-02 19:29 UTC by confidence/category filtering, boundary subsetting, OSM deduplication, and coordinate rounding

provenance.method: offline rebuild: the benchmark's frozen POI universe filtered with the shared boundary predicate (map/scripts/facilities_from_frozen_universe.py); no network request was made

dedup_rules.osm_internal: same name within 150 m, per category
dedup_rules.cross_source: merge_overture.same_place: exact name <300 m, name containment <150 m, or equal house-number + first street word

provenance.attribute_carry_over: kind, addr and osm id copied from the previous committed snapshot when the same named place of the same category lies within 150 m; null otherwise
provenance.note: Facility membership is dataset-to-display-boundary consistency only; it does not validate ten-minute drive-time accuracy.
